name: CSE Claw
description: Disabled-by-default passive bridge from OpenClaw turns to a local CSE cognition backend.

enabled.label: Enable CSE Claw
enabled.help: Opt in to sending redacted turn summaries to the configured local CSE backend. The bridge is advisory only.

endpoint.label: CSE Backend Endpoint
endpoint.help: HTTP(S) base URL for the local CSE service. Defaults to loopback.

timeoutMs.label: CSE Backend Timeout
timeoutMs.help: Milliseconds to wait before failing open without advisory context.

includeToolCalls.label: Include Tool Call Summaries
includeToolCalls.help: Default off. Sends only redacted tool-call summaries when enabled.
